name: JobsPipe
notes: Broad aggregator across 30+ job boards. See scripts/sources/jobspipe.py.

name: Openings MCP
notes: Company career pages / ATS coverage (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workday, SmartRecruiters, ...).

name: Indeed
notes: Use the built-in Indeed MCP tool (search_jobs / get_job_details) directly from the agent — no API key or script needed.

name: Wellfound
notes: No public API for individuals. Searched live via the Claude in Chrome extension.

name: Instahyre
notes: No public API. Searched live via the Claude in Chrome extension.

name: LinkedIn Jobs
notes: No public API for this use case. Searched live via the Claude in Chrome extension. Do not treat as the primary discovery source — use it to fill gaps and for outreach, not bulk search.

name: YC / Work at a Startup
notes: No public API. Searched live via the Claude in Chrome extension, or via an API-based aggregator if you have one that covers it.

name: custom-api-source
notes: Template for any other REST job-search API you have a key for. Duplicate this entry, rename it, fill in the endpoint, add the key to .env, and point scripts/sources/generic_api.py at it — or ask the agent to wire it up.
